title: سوپ با گوشت گاو | Voskes
heading: سوپ  WITH BEEF
description: سوپ گوشت گاو Voskes خوراکی خوشمزه‌ای است که گربه را به نوشیدن بیشتر تشویق و به آبرسانی بدن کمک می‌کند.
bodyDescription: Voskes Soup with Beef is a delicious snack that encourages cats to drink more and promotes hydration. If cats do not drink enough, there is a risk of urolite formation. Especially cats following a diet consisting mainly of dry food are susceptible to this. Voskes Soup with Beef is completely grain-free and no salt was added. Can be given separately as a drink or as a topping over kibble for extra flavour, ideal for picky cats!
